pages.title: Unified Notes III
pages.text: The last unified volume: surreal numbers, the omega point, degenerate matter, the stress-energy tensor, causal loops with no origin, magnetic monopoles. It is where my notes stop distinguishing between what is true of matter and what is true of number.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To close the unified record I needed the strangest proofs I owned: a surreal number, the omega point, a bootstrap artifact that has no beginning, a stress-energy tensor, degenerate matter and a monopole. Woven together, they read as a single theory.
